explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. The theorem is about `padicCompletionUnitsRepresentation`, which the library defines itself; a search of the Mathlib sources for that name finds nothing. The statement says that the degree-2 group cohomology of this representation, restricted to a subgroup S, is cyclic and has order p^(v_p(|S|)). The proof just takes the second component of the library's own lemma `groupCohomology_res_padicCompletionUnits`. All of the mathematical content comes from the library's own constructions in local class field theory, so Mathlib has nothing that this result duplicates or specialises.
